  20260703-094500-d-prc-cap process procedure decision [confidence: medium] () {status: active} The capture procedure is the shared spine for recording signals and decisions: assemble a graph-grounded draft, fold the writing guide's findings in by judgment — revising until the draft holds up (d-cpt-20r) — play the draft back for explicit user confirmation, write through the pre-flight gate whose override only the user can choose, then verify the generated summary for fidelity.   20260703-190000-d-prc-eng process procedure decision [confidence: medium] () {status: active} The engage procedure is the universal entry move for working on a specific entry: establish the anchor (plus connected targets), receive the full chains served at the brief step, synthesize a brief shaped by the anchor's kind and the user's goal, then put the candidate moves to the user at the junction. The picked move runs as its own procedure — engage ends by dispatching, not by acting.
  20260703-190100-d-prc-exp process procedure decision [confidence: medium] () {status: active} The explore procedure is a compression mission over a set of entries: read the whole surface in a disposable context — chains served in full, every pointer that could bear on the goal inspected via show, iterating until nothing new surfaces — then compress toward the goal into a briefing that keeps full IDs and enough context for the outer dialogue to act without re-reading. The gap was surfaced by wiring up the stored index in the viewer's search design (20260909-152707-d-tac-nqs), which is what made the discrepancy visible.
  20261023-180356-s-ops-e10 operational done signal [confidence: high] (Felix) <area-scaffold, defect> Git no longer tracks the go-task checksum cache under `source/.task/`. The change concerns the scaffold that pins go-task (20260829-205109-s-prc-xv4).
  20261023-180742-s-ops-poe operational done signal [confidence: high] (Felix) <area-scaffold, stack> Devbox now sets `GOROOT` to an empty value so the pinned Go toolchain always compiles against its own standard library. This fixes version-mismatch compile failures caused by a second Go install leaking its `GOROOT` into the environment that pins Go 1.26 (20260829-205109-s-prc-xv4), landed via commit `c2034cb` in `devbox.json` and covering both direnv and `devbox run`. A clean shell with a foreign `GOROOT` verifies the fix: `devbox run` passes `go vet` with the setting and fails without it.
